title: TikTok: New car vs used – where your money disappears (animated, emotional Andrew)
_sources: Kelley Blue Book / Cox Automotive ATP report Sept 2026 (13.10.2026): average new-vehicle transaction price $50,562. iSeeCars 'Cars That Hold Their Value' study 2026 (950k+ five-year-old cars, sales Mar 2025–Feb 2026): average 5-year depreciation 41.8%; best Porsche 718 Cayman 9.6%; worst Nissan LEAF 63.1%. Own calc: 50,562 x 41.8% = $21,135 lost in 5 years = $352/month; 5-year-old value ≈ $29,427.

lines.text: The average new car costs fifty thousand dollars. Five years later... twenty-one thousand of it is just gone.
That's three hundred fifty dollars a month. For nothing!
But here's the thing: not every car loses the same.
The worst one is the Nissan Leaf. It lost sixty-three percent of its value.
And the best one is a Porsche Cayman. It lost less than ten percent!
So here's the trick. Let someone else pay for the first five years.
Buy it five years old, and you keep twenty-one thousand dollars in your pocket!
